At the top of the stairs, protected by [1x Battle Droid & 1x Air Drone]

One of four generators needed to activate the [Hypertube Door Controls]

markers.title: Locked Gate
markers.desc:
At the leftmost edge of the area.

Its password (**ηεγβεγ**) is found on a [nearby corpse.]

markers.title: Powerless Gate
markers.desc: At the rightmost edge of the area - opens after using the [Power Panel].

markers.title: Power Panel
markers.desc: In the side-room. Restores power to the [Powerless Gate], and opens the side-rooms in the main corridor, after directing the circuits through their corresponding circles.

markers.title: Laser Panel
markers.desc: On the wall in the side-room. Use it to avoid an untimely death and claim the [Black Rose].

markers.title: Powerless Elevator
markers.desc: Activate the [Power Panel] to use it.

markers.title: Power Panel
markers.desc: In the side-room that opens after killing [Belial]. Restores power to the [Powerless Elevator], after directing the circuits through their corresponding circles.

markers.title: Button
markers.desc: Sends you to the next area.

markers.title: Arisa
markers.desc: Standing in the middle of the room. Speak to her, and she'll open the stairwell that leads to the second floor.

markers.title: Locked Door
markers.desc: Opens after [Karakuri] is defeated.

markers.title: Elevator Button
markers.desc: On your left when the doors open.
